newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnights down on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnights down on low demand.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates slipped at Wednesday's close amid low demand for funds, but dealers said overnight rates could rise on Thursday on settlement of an auction of short term federal bonds (STFBs).
Overnight offers started at eight percent ahead of an open market operation, but dropped to three percent, where they stayed till the close, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
The central bank picked up 1.7 billion rupees in its open market operation at a cut-off yield of 16.50 percent a year.
Overnights may rise on Thursday as 9.371 billion rupees flow out to settle the STFB auction against an inflow of 5.5 billion.
